The routing controller determines routing. Reservoirs provide buffering capacity; they do not choose routes.
Fill/store, buffer/hold and release are proposed continuous control states. The two reservoirs may differ.

The transport subsystem carries carrier locally. The routing controller distributes carrier and receives return. Reservoirs store, buffer and release.
Exchange between controller and reservoirs is internal redistribution. Internal transfer is not total-system gain or loss.
